inventory: All source-defined modules, classes and callables, including private and nested symbols; no import-time execution.

rust.command: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D missing_docs -D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -D rustdoc::invalid_codeblock_attributes' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked
rust.limitations: The source checker verifies explicit Cargo workspace membership but does not qualify Rust execution. Rust public API presence and links require the pinned compiler; passing documentation lints does not establish scientific validity or prose quality. PyO3-exported functions also need source doc comments because Rust visibility alone does not identify the Python API. innovate-games has a separate workspace and lockfile; the root workspace documentation and doctest commands do not qualify it.

qualification: A ratchet pass only prevents documented legacy gaps from growing or changing without review. Full acceptance also requires strict Python completeness, Rust compiler and doctest results, executable tutorial evidence, and human review of scientific explanation.

review_requirements.Errors: Fallible operations describe error cases and their returned representation.
review_requirements.Safety: Unsafe APIs describe caller preconditions, lifetimes and ownership.
review_requirements.Panics: APIs with caller-reachable panics describe their conditions.

r.style: roxygen comments with matching Rd help
